name: ibis Styles Bogor Raya
short_description: A 205-room design-economy hotel inside the Bogor Raya Golf Estate, 500 meters from the golf course and 8 minutes from the toll exit.
ai_summary: ibis Styles Bogor Raya is a 205-room, family-friendly design-economy hotel set within the Bogor Raya Golf Estate, about 500 meters on foot from Golf Bogor Raya and roughly 8 minutes from the toll exit. The eco-certified property centers on the 160-seat sTREATs Restaurant serving international and Indonesian cuisine, alongside a swimming pool, fitness center, kids' corner, and seven meeting rooms. Rooms run 23-33 sqm across Deluxe Twin, Deluxe Queen, Family, and Executive categories, with many overlooking the golf course. Guests consistently praise the cleanliness, attentive service, and value, while a subset find the golf-estate location a little secluded from central Bogor.

faqs.question: Is ibis Styles Bogor Raya close to the golf course?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it sits inside the Bogor Raya Golf Estate, about 500 meters on foot from the 18-hole Golf Bogor Raya course, and many of its 205 rooms overlook the fairways. The hotel is roughly 8 minutes from the Bogor toll exit, though central Bogor's attractions require a further drive.

faqs.question: Does ibis Styles Bogor Raya suit families?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it's positioned as an eco-certified, family-friendly hotel with a kids' corner, swimming pool, and Family Room options alongside its standard Deluxe Twin, Deluxe Queen, and Executive categories. The 160-seat sTREATs Restaurant serves an international and Indonesian buffet that works well for family groups.

reviews.title: Ibis Styles Bogor Raya — Bogor, Java
reviews.summary: Travel bloggers used the hotel as an overnight transit stop between the Gunung Padang megalithic site and Jakarta, praising the green golf-course views and rush laundry service.
